strategy.primary: Connect with Obeka (menace, evasion, protection), increase her damage or double her trigger, and turn the extra upkeep steps into cards, Treasures, Clues, tokens and counters through upkeep engines.
strategy.secondary: Time Sieve plus upkeep-made artifacts gives repeatable extra turns; Darksteel Reactor and Mechanized Production give alternate wins.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever Obeka deals combat damage to a player, you get that many additional upkeep steps after this phase.

identity.why: Turns upkeep artifacts into extra turns.
Treasure each upkeep, and a combo piece.
One mana: a card each upkeep.
